messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 1959991234 - spike: /v2/generate 5xx rate > 8/min (us-east-1). Pager triggered to oncall.

cj: seeing this on dashboards too — p95 latency up ~300ms and 5xx spike concentrated on a handful of hosts.

marta: oncall here, looking. Is this only in canary or across all clusters?

kai: looks like only us-east-1 prod, not eu or apac. top error message is 'connection reset by peer' from upstream inference service.

ash: initial impression: short-lived upstream connection churn after a recent infra kernel bump? correlating with a k8s node restart cluster event 02:31 UTC.

cj: can we confirm if customer-facing requests were impacted? ops-bot: (automated) route breakdown: 2 customers experienced errors out of 1,260 active sessions in the window (0.16%).

marta: thanks bot. low customer % but definitely noisy pager. I'll take live mitigation.

marta: mitigation plan: 1) mute noisy alert temporarily while we triage 2) apply a quick alert tweak to ignore known transient conn resets for this route 3) roll back kernel bump if evidence mounts.

kai: +1. For step 2, suggest we add a log-rule filter so the alert excludes errors containing known transient strings. Proposed regex: 

```
NOT message =~ "(UPSTREAM_RESET|connection reset by peer|ECONNRESET)"
```

cj: also propose tightening the query to focus on genuine 5xx patterns: we see a lot of client-side connection resets being mis-attributed. Current query: 

```
index=prod logs | where http.path=="/v2/generate" and status>=500 | count by host, error_message | window=1m
```

Proposed adjusted query: 

```
index=prod logs | where http.path=="/v2/generate" and status>=500 and not match(error_message, "(connection reset by peer|UPSTREAM_RESET|client closed)") | count by host | window=1m
```

ash: fine to push that as an emergency patch to alert rule. We should also add a new signature for the noisy transient so we can measure it separately: name it "transient-conn-reset-v2gen" and tag as suppression-eligible.

marta: muting alert for 30m while we push the query change and watch. Doing now. :zipper_mouth_face:

ops-bot: ACTION - Alert 'v2-generate-5xx-spike' muted by marta for 30m. Incident channel pinned.

cj: pushed the alert query change as emergency rule edit (no code deploy) — will share diff in a sec.

cj: diff snippet: 

```
- filter: status>=500
+ filter: status>=500 and not match(error_message, "(connection reset by peer|UPSTREAM_RESET|client closed)")
```

kai: logs look cleaner already — 5xx count drops by ~70% once we exclude the transient messages; remaining 5xx are actual inference errors (timeout / model OOM).

ash: good. can we add a short-term dashboard panel to track both signals: raw 5xx and 5xx-after-filter so we don't lose visibility? cj can you add a panel?

cj: adding a temporary panel to SRE > Incidents dashboard now. Link: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/sre/incidents#1959991234 (will be live in 2min)

marta: noted customer impact still small, but we should run a post-incident follow-up: 1) create a formal suppression signature for the transient resets, 2) consider increasing alert threshold from 5->10 per minute for this route, 3) add a note in runbook about kernel bump correlation.

ash: created a quick github ticket to track follow-ups: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/4821 - includes rollback check, kernel-bump correlation, and runbook edits.

cj: PR for alert rule change (hotfix) opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ops-config/pulls/920 - merging after 2 approvals.

oncall-manager: please ensure the change is logged in oncall handoff notes for next shift. Also schedule a deeper triage tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

marta: adding handoff notes now.

marta: summary for handoff - low customer impact (0.16%), noisy pager from transient upstream resets after kernel bump. Hotfix applied to alert query to exclude known transient messages, alert muted for 30m during mitigation, temporary dashboard added to monitor both raw and filtered 5xx. Follow-ups: infra ticket #4821, create signature "transient-conn-reset-v2gen", consider raising threshold to 10/min, runbook update.

cj: ops-bot confirms hotfix merged and rule deployed.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT - Ops config commit 7a3b9f applied to alerting pipeline.

marta: unmuted alert (30m) now; we'll watch for any real regressions but seems stable.

kai: monitoring shows no further host-wide surge. I'll continue correlating with infra team on kernel bump timeline.

ash: assign follow-ups: @cj - create dashboard permanent panel + link to ticket; @kai - follow infra rollback/patching; @marta - runbook + signature creation.

cj: will create dashboard PR and attach to ticket #4821.

kai: pinged infra on the kernel bump owners. They acknowledged and will triage.

marta: thanks team. Closing live mitigation. Will reopen if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: THREAD CLOSED - live mitigation ended at 1959991467. Follow-ups tracked in issue https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/4821.
